title: deploy.state_changed@1
description: A deployment of a resource moved on. Emitted when a deploy starts and when it ends: started, then succeeded, failed or rolled_back, tied together by corr.correlation_id. The resource itself goes deploying then running through resource.state_changed. Unknown fields are allowed.

kind.description: human, agent, scheduler, hook, reaction or system

artifact.description: A version, build id or digest. Not a path or URL with credentials.

reason.description: A short closed code, never an error message: build_failed, health_failed, rollback, operator_cancel.
